messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PAGER: P1 alert - unusual output pattern detected on prompt-routing-v2 canary (206 nodes). Error/failure signature: 'incoherent completions' spike. Root ts: 2160012345
Maria (eng-oncall): I got the pager, oncall taking it. Can someone post recent deploys?
deploy-bot: Deploy completed: prompt-routing-v2 canary -> 202 hosts rolled 14:02 UTC. Release ID: rel-prod-2026-04-06.
Tori (support): Seeing 3 tickets flagged as "nonsensical completions" from 2 customers (acct: acme, acct: travelly). Roughly 4-6% of requests affected per canary shard. Customers are on hosted API.
Sam (runtime): Visuals look bad — top-line metric is a jump in "semantic-fail" for prompt-routing-v2 at 14:04 UTC, correlated with new kernel path. Latency fine, but content quality regressed.
Kevin (eng-sre): Any rate / region pattern?
Sam (runtime): Mostly west-1 and eu-west-1 canaries. Not global yet.
Maria (eng-oncall): Ok — this is a quality regression. We need emergency mitigation: revert traffic for prompt-routing-v2 canary and flip the feature flag to route to stable router. Who can run the FF kill?
Product Ops: @Maria — we have a kill-switch flag: ff.prompt_routing_v2.enabled. Ops runbook says to set to false for prod slice.
Maria (eng-oncall): I'll run it. Posting command below.
Maria (eng-oncall): ```bash
redwood-ops feature-flags set ff.prompt_routing_v2.enabled false --env=prod --scope=canary --reason "Emergency: content quality regression in canary"
```
Sam (runtime): Copy. Also create a fallback route so sessions in flight can finish on the stable path.
Kevin (eng-sre): noted. I'll monitor request drift and error budget. Enabling extra logging for sample sessions.
deploy-bot: Feature-flag change requested by Maria. Executing...
deploy-bot: Feature-flag update succeeded: ff.prompt_routing_v2.enabled=false (applied to prod canary slice) at 2160012360
Maria (eng-oncall): Confirming via traffic dashboard: canary traffic routed back to prompt-router-stable. Quality metrics dropping back to baseline within 2 minutes. :thumbsup:
Tori (support): Notified affected customers and created follow-ups: TKT-4721, TKT-4722. Both customers acknowledged mitigation and want a writeup.
Sam (runtime): Collecting artifacts: sample bad completions, model/kernel trace, and canary shard IDs. Will attach to incident.
Kevin (eng-sre): Watching for residual errors — no surge in latency or errors after flip.
Maria (eng-oncall): Handing off to Sam for deep-dive / postmortem. Sam, you're primary for RCA. I'll stay on watcher for 30m.
Sam (runtime): Ack. I'll start with binary search on kernel selection and the new attention optimization path.
Product Ops: Customer comms template: "We've mitigated the issue by routing traffic back to the stable prompt router. Our team is investigating root cause and will follow up with technical details and ETA for a safe re-roll."
Tori (support): Updating both customers with that message now.
Maria (eng-oncall): Incident severity: P1 -> downgrade possible after Sam confirms artifact collection. Next steps: Sam to post RCA draft, Kevin to check autoscaling/rollout safeguards, Product Ops to coordinate customer notes.
Sam (runtime): Preliminary note: reproduction observed locally with the new kernel combo + long-context prompts. More analysis incoming.
Kevin (eng-sre): Recommend adding an emergency pre-commit check to block kernel combo if canary quality drops >2% from baseline. Filing runbook ticket.
Maria (eng-oncall): Good. Closing pager for active mitigation. Leaving the thread open for postmortem.
incident-bot: Pager cleared at 2160012460 by Maria. Incident state: mitigation applied (FF kill), ongoing RCA.
Maria (eng-oncall): TL;DR — emergency FF kill engaged, traffic routed to stable router, affected customers notified, RCA assigned to Sam. We'll schedule postmortem doc and a follow-up AAA (assign/assess/action) within 48hrs.
Sam (runtime): I'll drop artifacts into the incident folder and ping when RCA draft's ready.
Tori (support): TKT-4721/4722 updated. Customers happy with rollback for now.
Kevin (eng-sre): Filing monitoring alert tweak PR to add quality-signal threshold to canary gating.
Maria (eng-oncall): Thanks team. If anyone sees regression reappear, re-pager me immediately. :heart:
